Artists/Handmade Clay/Yuka Morii

Yuka Morii’sSculpted Moments

Yuka Morii hand-sculpts physical clay Pokémon and photographs them inside real-world miniature sets and natural landscapes. Her soft lighting and gentle clay textures give every card the nostalgic warmth of a beloved childhood storybook.

🏺 Handmade Clay📅 Cards since 2001🗂️ 215 cards across 85 sets
